args.code: (() => { const btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')); const ds = btns.find(b => /Draft Design System/.test(b.textContent)); if (!ds) return JSON.stringify({err:'no ds button', btns: btns.map(b=>b.textContent.trim()).slice(0,20)}); ds.click(); return JSON.stringify({clicked: ds.textContent.trim()}); })()
